title: Samples matrix, localization plan, and staged rollout for SDK & API surface (function-calling, structured output, streaming)
creator: Asha Patel
description: Create and coordinate a comprehensive samples matrix, localized sample translations, and a staged rollout plan for the upcoming SDK + REST API surface changes that add first-class support for function-calling, structured output schemas, and streaming responses. This ticket centralizes cross-functional tasks between PM, Docs, SDK, Console, and Design to ensure parity across languages (Python/TS/Go), CLI examples, and code samples embedded in docs and quickstarts.
acceptance_criteria: A1: Full samples matrix exists covering Python, TypeScript, Go, and curl for 3 scenarios: function-calling, structured-output (JSON schema + validation), and streaming responses
A2: Localized copy for en-US, en-GB, fr-FR, de-DE, and ja-JP present for top-3 samples in the docs portal
A3: All SDK samples compile/run in CI (unit test harness) and are included in SDK sample repo PR
A4: Release notes draft approved by Engineering and Docs owners and published to release branch two business days before GA
A5: Staged rollout plan with clear rollback triggers and metrics (error rate >1% or median latency regression >25%) is documented and validated with SRE

samples_matrix: Matrix rows: scenario (function-calling / structured-output / streaming), language (python/ts/go/curl), SDK version, expected output (JSON schema), example input prompts, test harness id

Canonical examples: Python function-calling using typed dataclasses; TS example using promise-based streaming with chunked JSON; Go example showing KV-cache warmup and function invocation; curl example for structured-output validation via response-schema header
Localization plan: translate inline prompts and user-facing comments; leave code identifiers untranslated; maintain identical test vectors across locales
Edge cases: show error handling for partial streams, schema mismatches, and function name collisions
rollout_plan: Phase 0: Internal canary (sdk-internal team) for 72h — smoke tests + sample CI green. Phase 1: Beta customers + internal partners (up to 10 customers) for 5 days — monitor errors and latency. Phase 2: Gradual GA: 25% traffic -> 50% -> 100% over 48h windows, with SRE watch and automated rollback if error rate threshold exceeded. Rollback triggers: service error rate >1% sustained for 15m, median 95th latency regression >25%, or sample validation failures in CI. Communication: Slack channel #launch-sdk-2025 and daily AM/PM summaries to GTM and Eng leadership.
release_notes_draft: New: First-class function-calling examples in Python, TypeScript, and Go with recommended patterns for typed inputs and safe invocation.
New: Structured-output support examples demonstrating response JSON schemas, validator snippets, and common validation patterns for downstream processing.
Improved: Streaming samples showing chunked response handling, incremental parser examples, and best-practices for stateful streaming clients.
Notes: Breaking changes are limited to SDK helper signatures for function-calling (minor version bump). See migration snippet in the docs. No change to core REST endpoints.
Known limitations: Localization covers top-3 samples; further translation will follow in GA+2 weeks. Streaming parity for Go SDK is experimental and clearly flagged in the samples.

risks: R1: Localized copy may lag and produce mismatched samples — mitigation: ship en-US first and gate localized pages behind a locale switch; schedule follow-up translation sprint.
R2: Streaming parity across SDKs (Go lagging) — mitigation: mark Go streaming as experimental, include server-side fallback guidance.
R3: Unexpected schema validation errors in customer integration — mitigation: include clear migration snippet and a schema-compatibility checklist in release notes.
R4: Docs build flakiness when running live sample harnesses — mitigation: add isolated test runners and retry logic; reduce live-run scope for GA.
